read.thesis: Bank of America Q4 2025: net income $7.6B (+12%), EPS $0.98 (+18%), 2026 NII guided +5-7% and ~200bp operating leverage; supply-side signals are headcount discipline and buybacks, but no capacity or pricing data for a cyclical read.

triggers.label: 2026 NII guided +5-7%
triggers.quote: we expect 5% to 7% growth in net interest income in 2026 compared to 2025

triggers.label: Headcount flat; AI cut ~2,000 coder roles
triggers.quote: we managed to hold our headcount flat for the year through good management

triggers.label: Q1 expenses ~4% higher YoY
triggers.quote: we expect Q1 expenses to be about 4% higher than Q1 of 2025

guidance.quote: we expect 5% to 7% growth in net interest income in 2026 compared to 2025
We expect to generate about 200 basis points of operating leverage in 2026.
we expect Q1 expenses to be about 4% higher than Q1 of 2025
embedded in our NII assumption is loan growth in the mid-single digits
For 2026, we expect an effective tax rate of roughly 20%.
maybe the 50% to 55% is the right number or through the cycle.

prior_guidance_check.quote: that's still our belief today based on the latest interest rate curve

red_flags.label: Proposed credit card rate caps
red_flags.quote: if you bring the caps down, you're going to get strict credit, meaning less people will get credit cards

red_flags.label: Stablecoin deposit outflow risk
red_flags.quote: they say you can see upwards of $6 trillion in deposits flow off the liabilities of a banking system
